title: Paleness
summary: PA'LENESS, noun Wanness; defect of color; want of freshness or ruddiness; a sickly whiteness of look. The blood the virgin's cheek forsook, A livid paleness spreads o'er all her look. 1. Want of color

inlines.v: PA'LENESS, noun Wanness; defect of color; want of freshness or ruddiness; a sickly whiteness of look. The blood the virgin's cheek forsook, A livid paleness spreads o'er all her look. 1. Want of color or luster; as the paleness of a flower.
